superseding_details.unit_reference: Use being changed from office and gym to ancillary residential accommodation in connect to the main house

description: Use of outbuilding as annexe ancillary to main residential use
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">Notwithstanding
the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or
without modification), no fencing or walls, which would sub-divide the site and
separate the outbuilding hereby approved from the residential curtilage of the
main dwelling, shall be constructed without planning permission first obtained
from the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">To safeguard the amenities of
neighbouring residents, to prevent the unauthorised introduction of an
independent use and to ensure compliance with the following Development Plan
policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies
D12.1 &amp; D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.<font face="Calibri, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.

No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
